import { rankingView, rankingFooter } from '@src/response/leaderboard/view';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 主线排行榜
 * 指令：/主线排行榜 [页码]
 * 按历史累计最高🌟排名前50
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/storyline/leaderboard/app';
import { sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayer';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const currentUid = e.uid as number;
  const msg = e.MessageText || '';
  const match = msg.match(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?主线排行榜(?:\s*(\d+|榜首|附近|我的))?$/);

  if (!match) {
    return;
  }

  const pageRaw = match[2];
  let page = pageRaw ? Number(pageRaw) : 1;

  if (!Number.isFinite(page) || page < 1) {
    page = 1;
  }

  const result = await App({ bid, uid: currentUid, page });

  if (result.code === 'LOCKED') {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '主线排行榜', realmName: result.data.realmName });

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '主线排行榜', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const view = rankingView(msg, result.data.self !== null);
  const items = view.nearby ? result.data.nearby : result.data.items;

  md.addText(result.data.self ? `我的排名：第${result.data.self.rank}名 · ${result.data.self.totalStars}🌟` : '尚无主线记录，完成主线挑战后参与排名');
  md.addNewline();
  if (items.length === 0) {
    md.addText('暂无排行数据');
  } else {
    for (const item of items) {
      const icon = item.rank === 1 ? '🥇' : item.rank === 2 ? '🥈' : item.rank === 3 ? '🥉' : `【${item.rank}】`;

      const btns: { label: string; command: string }[] = [{ label: '查看', command: `/查看信息 ${item.uid}` }];

      if (currentUid && currentUid !== item.uid) {
        btns.push({ label: '点赞', command: `/点赞人气 ${item.uid} storyline` });
      }

      md.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown([`${icon} ${item.name}${item.uid === currentUid ? ' 👈我' : ''}`, `ID:${item.uid} 星数:${item.totalStars}`], btns));
    }
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '主线排行榜',
      content: md,
      footer: rankingFooter('/主线排行榜'),
      nav:
        !view.nearby && result.data.totalPages > 1
          ? {
              current: result.data.page,
              total: result.data.totalPages,
              count: result.data.total,
              command: '/主线排行榜 {page}'
            }
          : undefined
    })
  );
});
